text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A government consultant looking into the management of the company operating ferry services to Malta's sister island of Gozo found serious mismanagement and said important documents were missing.

- Fish farm denied planning permission to turn former factory into land base. Residents of the southern village of Marsaxlokk said the land base would be an inconvenience because of the smell as well as noise.
- Talks being held between Thomas de La Rue, international security printing firm, and the General Workers Union over staffing at Malta plant.
